title: Services
description: Services of this computer (Windows services or systemd units): counts by state; anomalies (failed units, automatic services that are stopped, services restarting in a loop); services that crashed or failed over the last 7 days; security signals on Windows (unquoted binary paths with spaces, unsigned binaries outside the Windows folder); and the full list with name, description, state, startup type, account, PID, restart count (Linux) and binary path. Findings flag failed services, stopped automatic services, repeated crashes or restarts, unquoted paths and unsigned service binaries.

functions.name: list
functions.title: Liste filtrée
functions.description: Lists the services of this computer with filters on state, startup type and name or description text: name, description, state, startup type, account, PID and binary path.

parameters.name: state
parameters.label: État
parameters.description: Keep only services in this state.

parameters.name: startType
parameters.label: Démarrage
parameters.description: Keep only services with this startup type (auto = starts at boot, manual = on demand or static, disabled = disabled or masked).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.label: Texte
parameters.description: Keep only services whose name or description contains this text (case-insensitive).

functions.name: get_service
functions.title: Détail d'un service
functions.description: Details of one service of this computer: all properties (state, startup type, account, PID, binary, start time, last result), its dependencies in both directions (what it needs, what needs it), its recovery / restart options, and its latest log lines (systemd journal on Linux, Service Control Manager and its own events on Windows).

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Service
parameters.description: Service name (Windows: short name such as Spooler or display name; Linux: unit name, with or without .service).

functions.name: control
functions.title: Démarrer, arrêter ou redémarrer
functions.description: Starts, stops or restarts one service of this computer (its startup type is not changed). Windows: Start/Stop/Restart-Service, stopping dependent services too (needs administrator rights). Linux: systemctl start/stop/restart (needs root). The preview shows the service, its state, PID and the running services that depend on it; it is blocked for essential system or session services (RPC, LSM, D-Bus, journald, logind, display manager…), a service already in the requested state, a disabled or masked service, or missing rights. Returns the state and PID before and after.

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Service
parameters.description: Service name (Windows: short or display name; Linux: unit name, with or without .service).

functions.name: set_start_type
functions.title: Type de démarrage
functions.description: Changes the startup type of one service (its current state does not change). Windows: Set-Service -StartupType: auto, auto_delayed, manual or disabled. Linux: systemctl enable (auto), disable (manual or disabled), mask (masked: cannot start at all), unmask. Never for essential system or session services. The preview shows the services that depend on it; reversible with the same action.

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Service
parameters.description: Service name (Windows: short or display name; Linux: unit name).
